note: Two columns joined on each line, separated by reading order; page is custodial, crossing guard and cafeteria staff in several buildings so page school district-wide. Left column: CUSTODIAL STAFF (Continued) (line 1) then SCHOOL CROSSING GUARD (21), CAFETERIA STAFF (26). Right column: the cafeteria workers by printed building ('- Middle School' -> middle, '- Elementary School' -> passios (bare Elementary = Passios inferred), '- High School' -> high), then SCHOOL BUS CONTRACTORS (heading line 38, right column). Bus contractors (Abell, Barney, F. & L. Street Railway Company, Garneau, Paton, Warpula, lines 39-56) are contractors, not school staff, and are in ignored with no entries (heading 38 marked). Custodians: Doyle Elementary (night shift, transferred from High School 11/17/80); Letarte 'Primary School (Day Shift)' -> primary; Kenney 'Senior Groundsperson/Utility Person' and Kresser 'Maintenance/Mechanic' name no building -> district-wide; Bissonnette 'School Matron' (position eliminated 11/24/80 and transferred to Custodian at High School) -> high. Cynthia Powell crossing guard at Elementary School driveway -> passios. Stillman 'School Lunch Supervisor' and Souliere 'Bookkeeper for School Lunch Program' -> district-wide. A resignation note is inline on Stillman and Souliere. Role text continues on following lines (building on its own line): those lines ignored. Line 59 page number. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
